vendors.longDescription: RB2B is a website visitor identification tool that de-anonymizes the traffic coming to your site. By installing a lightweight pixel in your website's header, RB2B matches your visitors against a permissioned publisher network using a combination of first- and third-party cookies, device IDs, and IP addresses to identify the real people behind each visit. For US-based traffic, it delivers full profiles — including name, LinkedIn profile, and verified business email — directly to your team via Slack, Microsoft Teams, or your CRM. You can filter identified visitors by criteria such as company size, revenue, seniority, department, or geography, and route high-intent leads into automated outreach sequences or sales rep alerts. RB2B also provides company-level identification globally through a partnership with Demandbase. Person-level identification is limited to US IP addresses in order to comply with GDPR. The service is SOC2 Type II certified and CCPA compliant. By consenting to this technology, your visit data may be used to identify you and reach out to you through LinkedIn, email, or other channels.

vendors.shortDescription: Identifies the individual visitors browsing your website and reveals their professional profile.
